name: Friends of Parks and Nature Grants

funder.name: South Australia Department for Environment and Water

summary: Annual grants of up to AUD 15,000 for volunteer Friends of Parks and Nature groups doing conservation work in South Australian parks and reserves, including minor equipment, over up to 18 months.

status.quote: The 2026-27 round of Friends of Parks and Nature Grants is open for six weeks from 23 September 2026 and offers grants of up to $15,000 per application.

opens.quote: The 2026-27 round of Friends of Parks and Nature Grants is open for six weeks from 23 September 2026 and offers grants of up to $15,000 per application.

deadline.quote: The round will close on Wednesday 4 November, 2026, at 11:59pm.

applicant_types.quote: The Friends of Parks and Nature Inc. grant programs recognise the significant work undertaken by Friends of Parks and Nature volunteer groups supporting South Australia's national parks and conservation programs.
